description: Analyze the eigenvalue spectrum of the transition graph adjacency matrix for champion TMs. Spectral properties may predict which machines will exhibit complex behavior.
mathematical_formalization: A(M) = adjacency matrix of state transition graph; lambda_2(A) predicts mixing time
implementation_hypothesis: Compute spectral gap and Cheeger constant for transition graphs; correlate with simulation length
experiment_seed: Compute spectra for all known BB(4), BB(5), BB(6) champions and random machines; test spectral predictors
